meta.title: Week 4 · Directed disparity-filter backbone
meta.parameter: alpha is the endpoint significance threshold. Retain a directed arc when its outgoing-source or incoming-target disparity tail probability is less than or equal to alpha.
meta.null_model: At each node, normalized incident edge weights are compared with a uniform random allocation of that node's strength among its distinct incoming or outgoing neighbors.
meta.directionality: Direction is preserved: outgoing and incoming strengths and degrees are tested separately. The OR rule retains an arc if it is significant at either endpoint.
meta.interpretation: Excluded links fail this filter at the selected alpha; this does not establish that they are historically unimportant.
meta.weight_definition: Each directed edge weight is the count of links from source article to target article; duplicate directed pairs are summed.
